- [LTIE.9.5] **Cross-tier logical facts are uncoalesced.** Truth
  maintenance is per-tier: the receiving tier holds a published fact as an
  assertion of its own, one fact per identity, with no justifier from the
  publishing tier. An author needing tier-wide truth maintenance structures
  rules so that exactly one tier publishes a given logical fact.
  Restates [LTIE.4.6.2].
